name: 74464 · Tahlequah, OK
findings: ZIP 74464 (Tahlequah) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74464 (Tahlequah) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 74464 (Tahlequah) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).
